# Rule catalogue

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_rule_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

115 pattern rules across 12 packs, plus 22 Python AST rules and 13 JavaScript rules that need more than a pattern match.

| Severity | Rules |
| --- | --- |
| critical | 15 |
| high | 63 |
| medium | 32 |
| low | 5 |

Covering 59 distinct CWEs.

## Scanners

| Scanner | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `cicd` | CI/CD workflow security: trigger abuse, script injection, unpinned actions |
| `configs` | Environment files, Dockerfiles, compose and Kubernetes manifests |
| `dependencies` | Known-vulnerable dependency versions and supply-chain hygiene in manifests |
| `javascript` | JS/TS analysis over a comment- and string-stripped view, with request taint tracking |
| `pattern` | Rule-pack driven source matching with negative and proximity guards |
| `python-ast` | Python AST analysis with intra-procedural taint tracking |
| `secrets` | Hardcoded credentials: provider tokens, key material, high-entropy assignments |

## Python AST rules

These parse the file rather than matching text. Findings with confirmed taint are raised a severity level; findings the function already guards are lowered one and marked low confidence.

| Rule | Severity | What it means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `py.compile-tainted` | critical | compile() on attacker-controlled source |
| `py.eval-dynamic` | critical | eval()/exec() on a computed expression |
| `py.pickle-load` | critical | pickle/marshal load |
| `py.assert-security` | high | assert used for a security check |
| `py.django-debug-true` | high | DEBUG = True in settings |
| `py.flask-debug` | high | Flask app started with debug=True |
| `py.path-tainted` | high | Filesystem path derived from request data |
| `py.shell-dynamic` | high | Shell command built from a computed value |
| `py.sql-dynamic` | high | SQL statement assembled at runtime |
| `py.ssrf` | high | Outbound request to an attacker-controlled URL |
| `py.ssti` | high | Template compiled from a runtime string |
| `py.tls-verify-off` | high | TLS verification disabled (verify=False) |
| `py.yaml-unsafe-load` | high | yaml.load() without a safe loader |
| `py.django-allowed-hosts-wildcard` | medium | ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['*'] |
| `py.mktemp-race` | medium | tempfile.mktemp() is race-prone |
| `py.open-redirect` | medium | redirect() to a request-controlled target |
| `py.weak-hash` | medium | Weak hash algorithm |
| `py.weak-random` | medium | random module used where a CSPRNG is needed |
| `py.world-writable-chmod` | medium | chmod grants world write access |
| `py.request-no-timeout` | low | Outbound request without a timeout |
| `py.shell-true-literal` | low | subprocess called with shell=True |
| `py.swallowed-exception` | low | Broad exception silently swallowed |

| `js.eval-tainted` | critical | taint sink |
| `js.sql-tainted` | critical | taint sink |
| `js.path-tainted` | high | taint sink |
| `js.ssrf-tainted` | high | taint sink |
| `js.redirect-tainted` | medium | taint sink |
| `js.express-trust-proxy-all` | medium | static |
| `js.helmet-missing-csp` | medium | static |
| `js.jwt-hardcoded-secret` | critical | static |
| `js.prototype-pollution-sink` | medium | static |
| `js.dynamic-require` | high | static |
| `js.set-timeout-string` | high | static |
| `js.cookie-no-flags` | medium | static |

## Suppressing a rule

In the source, with the reason next to the code it excuses:

```python
# redassay: ignore py.shell-dynamic - the command is a module constant
subprocess.run(BACKUP_COMMAND, shell=True)
```

Across a path:

```bash
redassay suppress crypto.md5-sha1-usage --path "cache/**" --reason "content fingerprints"
```

Or for the whole repository, committed in `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
[tool.redassay]
disabled_rules = ["authz.missing-authorization-check"]
```

See [writing-rules.md](writing-rules.md) to add or override one.
